changelog.title: Independent backup schedules
changelog.description: Set separate schedules for Core and each DSP.
changelog.details: Platform owners can choose the frequency, time zone, and retention policy for Core, each DSP, and full-system backups independently. This keeps backup timing aligned with how your platform is used.

popup.title: Choose backup schedules by scope
popup.description: Set the schedules that fit your Core and DSP workloads.

changelog.title: Dashboard activity overview
changelog.description: See recent activity across your DSP workspace at a glance.
changelog.details: The activity overview brings recent workspace events into one place, so DSP owners can quickly understand what changed without opening each area of the dashboard.

popup.title: See activity at a glance
popup.description: Review recent workspace events from one dashboard view.

changelog.title: Team search finds every member
changelog.description: Find teammates quickly by searching their name or email.
changelog.details: Team search now checks the full member list and matches names and email addresses consistently, making it easier to find the person you need.
